metadata.title: Preparation of 5-(Triisopropylalkynyl)dibenzo[b,d]thiophenium Triflate (3-step synthesis)
metadata.purpose: Prepare an electrophilic alkyne-transfer reagent in three isolated steps: (A) oxidation of dibenzo[b,d]thiophene to its 5-oxide, (B) synthesis of a silyl-protected alkyne, and (C) triflic-anhydride-mediated coupling of the sulfoxide and the alkyne to the thiophenium triflate. This is the v0.3-native rewrite of the v0.2 stress-set example, replacing the stoichiometry-table and TLC-table workarounds with per-step materialUses (equivalents/limiting reagent), amountOfSubstance parameters, and acceptanceCriteria.
metadata.scope: Bench-scale (tens of mmol) preparation following Org. Synth. 2019, 96, 258-276. Requires Schlenk/inert-atmosphere technique, cryogenic cooling to -70 C, and flash chromatography. Not a green/large-scale process; product 3 is energetic and must not be heated above 100 C in the solid state.
metadata.estimatedTime: ~3-4 days (Step A: oxidation + drying/recrystallization; Step B: reaction warms over 16 h; Step C: reaction stirred 12 h + chromatography)
beforeYouBegin: Perform a full hazard/risk assessment for every reagent and operation at the planned scale (see Prudent Practices in the Laboratory, Ch. 4).
Steps B and C require rigorously dry solvents (THF, DCM, Et2O) and inert atmosphere; flame-dry glassware for Step C.
Have internal-temperature monitoring (thermocouple) ready for Steps A, B and C; the H2O2 oxidation in Step A can undergo a delayed runaway exotherm.
Step A intermediate 1 feeds Step C; Step B intermediate 2 feeds Step C. Scales are not identical across steps (A made on 54.3 mmol, C consumes 25.0 mmol of 1).

samples.name: 5-(Triisopropylalkynyl)dibenzo[b,d]thiophenium triflate (3)
samples.description: Final electrophilic alkynylating reagent (7.50 g, 58%, 98 wt%); energetic solid, do not heat >100 C.

steps.action: Equip a 100 mL two-necked flask with a thermocouple and PTFE stir bar (second neck open). Charge dibenzo[b,d]thiophene, then add trifluoroacetic acid; a white suspension forms.
steps.expectedResult: White suspension of dibenzothiophene in TFA.
steps.criticalNotes: Use internal-temperature monitoring throughout; the subsequent peroxide addition is highly exothermic.
steps.safetyNotes: TFA is corrosive; work in a fume hood with gloves.

steps.action: Add 35% aqueous H2O2 dropwise by syringe pump through PTFE tubing (no metal contact) over 2 h, keeping the internal temperature below 30 C. A clear solution forms; stir 10 min, then confirm consumption of starting material by TLC.

materialUses.rawText: 35% w/w aqueous H2O2 (4.67 mL, 54.3 mmol, 1.00 equiv)

parameters.formula: n = (V x rho x wt%)/M = (4.67 mL x ~1.13 g/mL x 0.35)/34.01 g/mol = 54.3 mmol
controlled addition rate = 120 min / 4.67 mL = 25.7 min/mL
parameters.rawText: added dropwise by syringe pump ... over 2 h
keeping the internal temperature below 30 C

acceptanceCriteria.classification: product (sulfoxide 1) Rf 0.05; starting dibenzothiophene Rf 0.75; sulfone over-oxidation by-product Rf 0.16
acceptanceCriteria.description: Endpoint: starting material no longer detectable; product spot at Rf 0.05.

steps.expectedResult: Clear solution; starting material no longer detectable by TLC.
steps.criticalNotes: Highly exothermic with possible delayed runaway if run cold; keeping internal T below 30 C avoids sulfone over-oxidation.
steps.safetyNotes: H2O2 is a strong oxidizer; avoid metal contact (use PTFE tubing). Caution: highly exothermic.

sourceReferences.excerpt: added dropwise by syringe pump ... over 2 h. Caution: the reaction is highly exothermic

steps.action: Pour the mixture into chilled water; filter the suspension through a 10 um sintered glass frit and wash with ice-cold water. Dry the solid on the frit under a stream of air.

repeat.over: ice-cold water wash of the filter cake
repeat.notes: Applies to the 2 x 60 mL wash only; the quench and filtration are single operations.

parameters.rawText: washed with ice-cold water (2 x 60 mL)
dried on the frit under passage of air for 2 h

steps.expectedResult: Crude off-white solid of 1 collected on the frit.
steps.criticalNotes: Aqueous workup only; product isolated by filtration, not phase separation.

steps.action: Recrystallize the crude solid from toluene: suspend in toluene and heat until fully dissolved, cool to room temperature unassisted to grow needles, age 2 h, filter, wash with ice-cold toluene, and dry in vacuo to afford 1 as white needles.

parameters.formula: heat to at least the dissolution temperature (~90 C observed)

parameters.rawText: aged at room temperature for 2 h

acceptanceCriteria.description: 9.03 g of 1 as white needles (reference run).

steps.expectedResult: 1 as white needles: 9.03 g, 81% yield, 97 wt% purity; mp 188 C.
steps.criticalNotes: Unreacted dibenzothiophene is removed by recrystallization; if sulfone by-product is present, purify 1 by flash chromatography (DCM/MeOH 50:1 -> 25:1) instead. Safe pause point: 1 may be stored.

steps.action: Under N2, charge a flame-dried 250 mL three-necked flask (N2 inlet, septum, thermocouple, stir bar) with TMS-acetylene and dry THF. Cool the clear solution in an isopropanol/dry-ice bath to internal -70 C.

parameters.formula: n = V x rho / M = 4.58 mL x ~0.71 g/mL / 98.22 g/mol = 33.0 mmol

steps.expectedResult: Clear cold solution ready for deprotonation.
steps.safetyNotes: TMS-acetylene and THF are highly flammable; maintain inert atmosphere.

steps.action: Add n-BuLi dropwise at a rate that keeps the internal temperature below -60 C. Ten minutes after addition, remove the cooling bath and warm the solution to 0 C.

materialUses.rawText: n-BuLi (2.5 M in hexane; 13.2 mL, 33.0 mmol, 1.08 equiv)

parameters.formula: n = C x V = 2.5 mol/L x 13.2 mL = 33.0 mmol

parameters.rawText: keeps the internal temperature below -60 C

steps.safetyNotes: n-BuLi is pyrophoric and reacts violently with water; add under N2 with proper syringe technique.

steps.action: Re-cool to internal -60 C, add TIPSCl over 5 min, then allow the clear solution to warm slowly to room temperature over 16 h.

materialUses.role: silylating agent (limiting reagent for Step B)

parameters.rawText: cooled ... to an internal temperature of -60 C

parameters.formula: n = V x rho / M = 6.55 mL x ~0.901 g/mL / 192.80 g/mol = 30.6 mmol

parameters.rawText: warm up to room temperature over 16 h

steps.action: Pour the mixture into a separatory funnel containing saturated aqueous NH4Cl; add MTBE to form a biphasic mixture and separate. Extract the aqueous phase twice more with MTBE, wash the combined organics with brine, dry over MgSO4, and concentrate under reduced pressure to give 2 as a colorless oil.

repeat.over: MTBE extraction of the aqueous phase
repeat.notes: 2 x 100 mL, following the initial 50 mL partition (three MTBE portions total).

acceptanceCriteria.description: 7.42 g of 2 as a colorless oil (reference run).

steps.expectedResult: 2 as a colorless oil: 7.42 g, 95% yield, 99 wt% purity. Safe pause point.
steps.criticalNotes: Standard aqueous workup: quench, three MTBE portions total, brine wash, MgSO4 drying, rotary evaporation.

steps.action: Flame-dry a 250 mL three-necked flask (N2 line, septum, thermocouple, 2.5 cm stir bar) under N2. Charge with sulfoxide 1 and dry DCM, then cool to internal -50 C with a cryocooler.

materialUses.role: substrate (limiting reagent; isolated in Step A)

steps.expectedResult: Clear cold solution of 1 in DCM.
steps.criticalNotes: Uses intermediate 1 from Step A (sample sp1); rigorously anhydrous conditions required.

steps.action: Add triflic anhydride slowly over 5 min by syringe pump, forming an intense orange/red suspension. Stir 45 min at -50 C.

parameters.formula: n = V x rho / M = 4.20 mL x ~1.677 g/mL / 282.13 g/mol = 25.0 mmol

parameters.rawText: added over 5 min by syringe pump

steps.safetyNotes: Tf2O is corrosive, moisture-sensitive and a lachrymator; add under N2.

steps.action: Add a solution of alkyne 2 in dry DCM over 5 min by syringe pump. Warm to -15 C over 1 h (the suspension becomes a clear light-brown solution) and stir at -15 C under N2 for 12 h. Monitor by TLC.

parameters.formula: n = V x rho / M = 7.90 mL x ~0.81 g/mL / 254.56 g/mol = 25.0 mmol

parameters.rawText: added ... over 5 min by syringe pump
allowed to warm to -15 C over one hour
stirred at this temperature under N2 for another 12 h

acceptanceCriteria.parameter: TLC monitoring (20% acetone in CH2Cl2, UV 254 nm)
acceptanceCriteria.description: Endpoint: conversion to the product spot at Rf 0.34.

steps.expectedResult: Clear light-brown solution; TLC shows conversion to product (Rf 0.34).

steps.action: Quench with methanol. Transfer to a 500 mL flask, add silica gel, and concentrate to dryness to adsorb the crude product onto silica.

materialUses.rawText: quenched by addition of methanol (5 mL)

parameters.rawText: quenched by addition of methanol (5 mL)

steps.action: Dry-load onto a packed silica column (95 g, 16.0 x 6.0 cm, sand cap). Elute first with DCM (discard) then with DCM:acetone 4:1, collecting fractions.

parameters.formula: 4:1 of 2 L total = 1600 mL DCM + 400 mL acetone

steps.expectedResult: Product-containing fractions (by TLC); first 500 mL DCM fraction discarded.
steps.criticalNotes: By-products are non-polar or near baseline; large fractions may be collected.

steps.action: Partially evaporate the product fractions to ~15 mL. Add Et2O slowly over 5 min to precipitate 3 as a white microcrystalline powder; cool to 0 C, filter, and wash with Et2O to afford pure 3.

materialUses.rawText: Slow addition of Et2O (100 mL) over 5 min

parameters.rawText: solvent partially evaporated (40 C, 600 to 375 mmHg)
cooled to 0 C in an ice bath

acceptanceCriteria.description: 7.50 g of 3 as a white microcrystalline powder (reference run).

steps.expectedResult: 3 as a white microcrystalline powder: 7.50 g, 58% yield, 98 wt% purity; mp 155 C (dec).
steps.criticalNotes: 3 is energetic (>600 J/g on decomposition above 155 C). Do not heat the solid above 100 C; evaluate any heating of multigram quantities above 80 C by isothermal DSC.
steps.safetyNotes: Energetic solid; store cool, avoid heat and mechanical/thermal stress.

sourceReferences.excerpt: afford pure 3 (7.50 g, 58% yield, 98 wt% purity)

expectedOutputs: Step A: Dibenzo[b,d]thiophene-5-oxide (1) as white needles, 9.03 g, 81% yield, 97 wt% purity, mp 188 C.
Step B: Triisopropyl((trimethylsilyl)ethynyl)silane (2) as a colorless oil, 7.42 g, 95% yield, 99 wt% purity.
Step C: 5-(Triisopropylalkynyl)dibenzo[b,d]thiophenium triflate (3) as a white microcrystalline powder, 7.50 g, 58% yield, 98 wt% purity, mp 155 C (dec).
Characterization data (1H/13C/19F NMR, IR, HRMS) consistent with each structure.

troubleshooting.problem: Sulfone over-oxidation by-product in Step A
troubleshooting.cause: Internal temperature allowed to exceed 40 C during H2O2 addition
troubleshooting.solution: Keep internal T below 30 C and quench promptly once SM is consumed; if formed, purify 1 by flash chromatography (DCM/MeOH 50:1 -> 25:1) rather than recrystallization.

troubleshooting.problem: Delayed runaway exotherm in Step A
troubleshooting.cause: Reaction run cold (e.g. 0 C) so oxidation is slow with delayed onset
troubleshooting.solution: Run at 20-25 C with internal-T monitoring and 2 h peroxide addition; test for onset by adding a small peroxide portion and watching for a T rise.

troubleshooting.problem: Poor TLC resolution in Step A monitoring
troubleshooting.solution: Dilute an aliquot with ethyl acetate / saturated aqueous NaHCO3 and spot the organic layer.

troubleshooting.cause: Product co-eluting or lost in the early DCM fraction
troubleshooting.solution: Discard the first 500 mL DCM fraction; collect and TLC 100-200 mL fractions of the 4:1 DCM:acetone eluent.

safety: Carry out a full hazard/risk assessment for every substance and operation before starting (see Prudent Practices in the Laboratory, Ch. 4).
Step A H2O2/TFA oxidation is highly exothermic with possible delayed runaway if run cold; use internal-temperature monitoring and add peroxide over 2 h via PTFE tubing (no metal contact).

n-BuLi is pyrophoric; Tf2O and TIPSCl are moisture-sensitive and corrosive; TMS-acetylene, THF, MTBE and Et2O are highly flammable; DCM is a suspected carcinogen. Use inert atmosphere and a fume hood.

Product 3 is an energetic solid (>600 J/g on decomposition above 155 C). Do not heat the solid above 100 C; evaluate any heating of multigram quantities above 80 C by isothermal DSC. Drop-weight testing (3 x 30 J) showed no impact sensitivity.

compliance.wasteDisposal: Collect halogenated (DCM) and non-halogenated organic solvent waste separately. Cautiously quench pyrophoric n-BuLi residues and excess Tf2O/TIPSCl before disposal. Treat product 3 residues as thermally sensitive/energetic.
compliance.notes: No animal or human subjects. A documented chemical-hazard risk assessment is required per institutional rules before starting.

limitations: Bench-scale procedure; larger scales of the Step A oxidation may require added cooling and slower peroxide addition due to reduced surface-area-to-volume ratio. GHS hazard codes are not provided in the source and are marked needsReview where supplemented. The CAS number of the isolated alkyne 2 (m22) is not confirmed. Molar amounts derived via the formula fields use approximate reagent densities (flagged with '~'); the mmol/equivalents themselves are taken verbatim from the source. Product 3 is thermally sensitive and not suitable for high-temperature storage or use.
